name: rss-feed-index
description: Crawler + website for the feeds of the top 1 million websites

scripts.systemd-install: cp rss-feed-index.service ~/.config/systemd/user/ && sed -i "s|REPLACEME_WORKDIR|$(pwd)|" ~/.config/systemd/user/rss-feed-index.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now rss-feed-index.service
scripts.systemd-uninstall: systemctl --user stop rss-feed-index.service && systemctl --user disable rss-feed-index.service && rm ~/.config/systemd/user/rss-feed-index.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload
